Every single neuron can easily achieve a positive pre-activation and remains active in the network. There are no dead neurons.

The weights are completely normally distributed (roughly between -2.5 and +2.5), typical of a small MLP trained via backpropagation.

Everything about this network looks perfectly ordinary and functional. There are no statistical anomalies, hidden binary data in signs, or manually injected constants.
